title: Anpan (Sweet Red Bean Buns) あんパン - Okonomi Kitchen
ldKeywords: sweet red bean paste, japanese bread
ldIngredientsRaw: 300 grams sweet red bean paste (smooth, chunky or mashed)
black sesame seeds or poppy seeds
Yudane: 60 ml water + 40 g bread flour
20 g unsalted dairy free butter, softened
2-2.5 tbsp (30-37.5 ml) water (adjust based on humidity)
ldInstructionsRaw: Step 1: Make the Yudane (Optional, skip this step if making straight method)
htmlIngredientLines: Bread flour and Cake flour: this combination of flours make the perfect soft textured bread but you can substitute the total amount for all purpose flour.
Red bean paste (anko): You can use smooth bean paste (koshian), chunky bean paste (tsubuan) or mashed sweet bean paste (tsubushian)
Black sesame seeds or poppy seeds
